{{Location disambiguation 2|other=Ascalon Academy (PvP battle)|otherdesc=a PvP instance}} {{Mission infobox | name = Ascalon Academy | campaign = Prophecies | region = Ascalon (pre-Searing) | type = Cooperative | partysize = 4 | duration = Short | preceded by = [[Ascalon Academy (PvP battle)]] | followed by = [[The Krytan Ambassador]] }} The [[Ascalon Academy]] is the central training institution of the [[Ascalon Army]]. Its main building has two distinct clock towers. Access is gained by talking to [[Sir Tydus]] and fulfilling the requirements. This mission takes place immediately after a [[Ascalon Academy (PvP battle)|Player vs Player battle]]. If there are no other players entering the Ascalon Academy, then you will skip the PvP battle completely, and be treated as if you lost (but you will still be able to do the mission). After competing in the battle, players are taken to this instance where they must accompany [[Prince Rurik]] to defeat the [[Charr]] agent [[Vatlaaw Doomtooth]]. == Mission information == === Requirements === {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | test = y }} *Having chosen a secondary profession === Objectives === * Listen to the briefing given by Sir Tydus and Prince Rurik. * ADDED: Journey to the old bunker with Prince Rurik and defeat Vatlaaw Doomtooth and his minions. == Walkthrough == Follow Prince Rurik into the cave and kill the Grawl and Vatlaaw Doomtooth. Prince Rurik is strong enough to easily defeat all enemies on his own. As such, if your party includes henchmen, consider placing a [[Hero flag]] to leave the henchmen at the starting point, since this will allow you to keep all experience and loot from the enemies.

Completing this mission will trigger [[the Searing]] and take you to post-Searing Ascalon. == NPCs == === Allies === [[File:Ascalon Academy 01.jpg|thumb|250px]] [[File:Ascalon Academy2.jpg|thumb|250px]] [[Human]]s * {{w}} 10 [[Prince Rurik]] * {{w}} 2 [[Drill Sergeant Mahoney]] * {{w}} 2 [[Sir Tydus]] * {{w}} 2 [[Ascalonian Guard]] * {{mo}} 5 [[Academy Monk]] ====Conditional allies==== Up to three of these [[henchman|henchmen]] join the player's [[party]] if there is an insufficient amount of team members otherwise. If there is only one player in the party (you), then Alesia, Stefan, and Orion will join the party. Your days of harrying the citizens of Ascalon are over!"'' {{sic|Rurik repeats the same phrase}} :'''Prince Rurik''':''"My name is Prince Rurik, and I shall be your nemesis!"'' :'''Prince Rurik''':''"Foul nightmares of Grenth, be gone!"'' == Notes == * Mechanically, this area is an [[explorable area]], however it acts the same as a [[mission]]. * While waiting for the mission to start, your character will be teleported away from any [[portal]] you approach. * During the briefing, you cannot pass the [[Ascalonian Guard]]s at the top of the stairs; they will [[body block]] you. * Once this mission has started, your character will no longer be able to return to pre-Searing Ascalon; if you resign or logout/login, you will restart the mission.
